================================================================================
SECTION 3: FEATURED PROJECTS & CASE STUDIES
================================================================================

1. HostelSarathi — Digital Hostel & Student Accommodation Platform
   - Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Technical SEO
   - Description: HostelSarathi is a flagship web application engineered to transform student hostel discovery in Nepal. It offers verified hostel listings, interactive location searching, real-time room and bed availability tracking, resident stay history management, and multi-role dashboards for hostel managers and residents.

2. AI-MOS — Enterprise AI Management Operating System
   - Tech Stack: Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
   - Description: An enterprise-grade AI operating platform that manages corporate knowledge bases, automates agentic task queues, provides GraphQL query resolvers for microservices, and delivers high-fidelity administrative dashboards for AI agent monitoring.

3. Prabidhi Nepal — 3D Technological District Journey
   - Tech Stack: React, React Three Fiber, Three.js, Tailwind CSS
   - Description: An immersive, award-winning 3D web experience taking users on a cinematic journey through 11 interconnected technological districts representing the future of Nepal's tech ecosystem.

4. Live Cricket AI Commentary & Audio Synthesis Pipeline
   - Tech Stack: Python, Groq LLM (Llama 3.1), CricAPI, Edge-TTS, Pygame CE
   - Description: A real-time commentary engine that fetches live cricket match telemetry, feeds match situations into Llama 3.1 via Groq LLM for persona-driven commentary, and synthesizes natural audio output using Edge-TTS.
